from s8_grades import Gradebook

def test_percent():
    # Create a gradebook
    g = Gradebook()
    
    # Add students
    g.add_student("Alice")
    g.add_student("Bob")
    
    # Add assignments
    g.add_assignment("Homework 1", 100)
    g.add_assignment("Exam 1", 200)
    
    # Test with no scores
    assert g.percent("Alice") is None
    
    # Test with scores
    g.record("Alice", "Homework 1", 85)
    g.record("Alice", "Exam 1", 180)
    
    # Should be (85 + 180) / (100 + 200) = 265 / 300 = 0.8833... -> 88.33
    assert g.percent("Alice") == 88.33
    
    # Test with Bob who has no scores
    assert g.percent("Bob") is None
    
    # Test with unknown student
    try:
        g.percent("Charlie")
        assert False, "Should have raised KeyError"
    except KeyError:
        pass  # Expected
    
    print("All percent tests passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_percent()
